tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; curl against POST {base}/chat/completions
chaining: pairs with a batch job that does not care which model runs; the single backend is the scarce link, and the prober puts it at 96 per cent of accepted calls

limits.value: free account API key: 60 requests per minute and 1,000 requests per month; no keyless API limit is published
anonymous web use: 6,000 tokens per day, reset at midnight UTC; free account: 30,000 tokens per day

free_tier.stated: 513 model entries in /v1/models, 45 of them marked self_hosted true; every id probed answers from one backend, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct
free_tier.notes: the catalogue carries prompt and completion prices of '0' per entry. The count 513 is the length of the models array, measured today

identity_cost.detail: no key required. The prober's per-endpoint track record reports 194 of 732 calls answered over 10 days, 27 per cent, and 194 of the 202 calls free.ai accepted for a model it serves, 96 per cent

reliability_note: no substitution was observed inside a single run, but the model served never matches the model requested for any id other than the backend's own name
confidence_note: the substitution was measured three times in run 1 and twice in run 2, plus once with a different id. What remains unmeasured is whether any of the 45 self-hosted entries is served as named.

evidence.quote: Sign up free at /signup/ and confirm your email - that unlocks the 30,000-token daily free pool. Open /account/?tab=api and click Generate.

evidence.proved: one POST with no Authorization header for qwen7b answered 200 with content NEEDLE-9K2X and echoed model Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct (not qwen7b); body free_ai_usage reports tokens_used 37, tokens_charged 37, source self_hosted; no rate-limit header was returned (headers: server nginx/1.18.0, content-length 822)

notes: The catalogue is 513 names for approximately one backend. Any capacity or quality claim about free.ai is a claim about Qwen3-30B-A3B, and a benchmark keyed on the requested id would be attributed to a model that never ran.
binding_note: no quota binds above a user's  scale: every id probed answered 200 with no key, in both runs. The failure here is substitution and not a ceiling, and substitution is not one of the six constraint kinds, so it is recorded in limits_note rather than forced into a kind that would misdescribe it
limits_note: the served model is the constraint: 513 catalogue names resolve to one backend, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct, so the model cannot be chosen and a capacity claim about free.ai is a claim about that one model. The prober's accepted-only rate for this endpoint is 194 of 202 calls, 96 per cent, so it answers reliably; what it does not do is serve what was asked for
